<!-- prop-1: body_md -->
. All of the eligible EP5 parameters
$X=X^{(EP5)}$
are
defined as real roots of the quartic (i.e., exactly solvable) polynomial
 \begin{equation}
 Z(K,X)=K^3\,Y(K,X)+K\,Y(K,X)\,Q_K\,X^2
 -\,Q_{K+1}\,Y^2(K,X)-K^2\,(K-1) (X-1)^2\,
 \label{nereska}
  \end{equation}
at all $K = 2, 3, \ldots$.
<!-- end prop-1 -->
